The hypothesis is that ants defend the plant by killing or chasing away leaf-feeding insects.  
To test this, you would remove ants and see if leaf damage increases — which is exactly what option (A) describes.  

Other options test different relationships:  
(B) tests whether oil-rich bodies affect ant density.  
(C) tests whether thorns affect ant density.  
(D) tests whether leaf-feeding insects affect ant density.  

Only (A) directly tests the defensive role of ants against herbivores.  

Final answer: (A)
